title: CMV Antiviral Resistance Database
description:
A curated, searchable database of cytomegalovirus (CMV) antiviral-resistance mutations, built from a systematic review of the published literature. It combines a random-effects meta-analysis of recombinant-phenotyping EC50 data with published patient reports, and assigns resistance levels for ganciclovir, cidofovir, foscarnet, letermovir and maribavir.

Website: https://virusnerd5.github.io/cmv-resistance-db/
